title: Which constant wins?
hook: The data stay fixed. The penalty changes.

knows: Small arithmetic and the prerequisites listed below.
doesNotKnow: the loss function changes the best constant prediction even on identical data. Compare squared versus absolute loss, rather than treating the mean as the one correct summary.

misconception: the loss function changes the best constant prediction even on identical data. Compare squared versus absolute loss, rather than treating the mean as the one correct summary.

claims.text: Sum squared error and sum absolute error are computed separately over the same targets. [0,0,9] has mean3/median0, squared costs81/54/162 and absolute9/12/18 at constants0/3/9.
